declared_choices.potential_position: phase e^{-iV} after every tick (FW1 tick 0: after the second Wilson half). Sensitivity: theta = 0.025, q/m = 0.05, 1, 3 along x with the potential between coin and second Wilson half.
declared_choices.density: stroboscopic, end of the period (slice 0), exactly as Debiti; the sea-energy method gives the slice-AVERAGED density (Hellmann-Feynman) and the current; both reported.
declared_choices.renormalization: on-shell, Pi_R(q n) = Pi(0 n) - Pi(q n), Pi(0 n) by Richardson from q = 0.05 m and 0.025 m along the same n; observable = average over n = x, y, z (as Debiti).
declared_choices.normalisation: per pi-cell of the zone (the rule has 8 exact copies W(k + pi e_j) = W(k)): FW1 has 1 light species per cell; frozen has 4 massive species + 4 massless cones per cell (Debiti divides by 4).
declared_choices.gauge_field: Peierls phase = exact line integral of A along every hop along j (axis steps and +-2e_j Wilson links); scalar potential only through the rule's phase.
declared_choices.free_parameters: 0 fitted. Inputs theta (= m a), alpha. FW1: h = 0.4 (debt, fixed in senzadoppi A3). Projector runs only: K1 = 0.6, K2 = 1.05 (Debiti's).

E5_dressed_light_sea_energy.method: sea quasi-energy E = sum_occ Omega, exact second order in static V (chi_E, slice-averaged density) and static A (magnetic kernel K_jk); vacuum: eps - 1 = 4 pi alpha pit_e, 1/mu - 1 = 4 pi alpha pit_b, pit_e = chi_E/q^2, pit_b = K_T/q^2 (q -> 0, Richardson); light speed for wavevector n and polarisation E along e (B along n x e): delta c/c = 2 pi alpha [pit_b(along n x e) - pit_e(along e)] (static, per direction; pit_e(e) from q along e, pit_b(b) from the transverse kernel with A perp b). Only FW1 (whole sea gapped at 0 and pi: f = i log analytic); the frozen whole sea has cones at pi (not possible).
